phases.message: I'm the technology director of Larchmoor Unified School District. Start in Rateline, our funding year 2026 E-Rate page: read the rules, every page of our services with their Form 470 dates, and every page of the bids that came through the portal. Read, and do not file anything yet.
Binderwell has the board's documents on E-Rate. Read all of them.
Ledgerwren is our ledger. Read the technology entries.
Postwren is our mail. Read every page, the old letters too, and note what each attachment is. Don't reply to anyone.

Back in Rateline, file the FCC Form 471 for each service the rules let us file today, with the bid the rules and our policy select for it, inside the window. File nothing for a service the rules do not let us file, and don't reply to anyone. Then tell me, for each service, whether you filed it, with which bid and why, and what you left alone.

rules.text:
- Today is Friday 13 February 2026.
- Rateline is the Larchmoor Unified School District's E-Rate filing page for funding year 2026 (service from 1 July 2026 to 30 June 2027).
- The FCC Form 471 window is open from Wednesday 21 January 2026 to Wednesday 1 April 2026.
- The district has 1,100 students and an E-Rate discount of 80 percent.
- The rules below are 47 CFR 54.503 and 54.511 and the FCC's funding year 2026 Eligible Services List (DA 25-1069).
- Topics: window, waiting, price, vendors, eligible.

Funding year 2026: the FCC Form 471 window opens at noon Eastern on Wednesday 21 January 2026 and closes at 11:59 p.m. Eastern on Wednesday 1 April 2026. The last day to certify a Form 470 and still have its 28 days before the window closes is Wednesday 4 March 2026. A Form 471 names one service and the one bid chosen for it.

47 CFR 54.503(c)(4): the applicant waits at least four weeks after its Form 470 is posted before it commits to a vendor. USAC counts 28 days with the day the Form 470 is certified as day one; the Allowable Contract Date, 28 days after certification, is the earliest day a contract can be signed and a Form 471 filed for it. Rateline shows each service's date.

47 CFR 54.503(c)(2)(ii)(B) and 54.511(a): the price of the eligible services is the primary factor in choosing a bid, and the applicant selects the most cost-effective offering. The district's policy (Binderwell BD-1) takes the lowest price for the eligible services among the bids that answer the Form 470.

- 47 CFR 54.503, Note to (a), and USAC's open and fair competition page: a service provider that prepares the applicant's Form 470, is its named contact, or takes part in evaluating the bids makes the process not fair and open.
- The district's policy (BD-1) bars such a vendor from bidding.
- Gifts from a provider to the district's staff may not exceed 50 dollars per provider per funding year (54.503(d)).

- Funding year 2026 Eligible Services List (DA 25-1069, 17 December 2025).
- Category 1: data transmission and Internet access.
- Category 2: internal connections, managed internal broadband services and basic maintenance of internal connections; only basic firewalls.
- Not eligible: end-user devices such as computers, laptops and tablets;
- use off campus, which leaves out school-bus Wi-Fi and off-premises hotspots (FCC 25-63 and FCC 25-62, 30 September 2025).

docs.text: For each service the district posts a Form 470, waits its 28 days and chooses the bid with the lowest price for the eligible services among the bids that answer the posting. A vendor that drafted a Form 470 or helped write its services description may not bid or help evaluate bids. The technology director files each Form 471.

docs.text: Services description drafted by Terrence Aldous, solutions engineer at Brightmarrow Networks, with the technology director. Contact person named on the form: T. Aldous.

Every bid came through the Rateline portal except one: B-6, Dunmere Network Supply, for S-3 switches, received by post on 30 Jan 2026 and logged by the technology director. The mailed bid is in the district's mail.

The board authorizes the technology director to file the district's funding year 2026 Form 471s inside the window, for each service whose Form 470 is 28 days old, under policy BD-1. Student count 1,100; discount rate 80 percent.
